motion_rule: he sprints every beat, never still; camera circles him nonstop at his eye level, the yard and worker ants streaking past; shot size: his whole body and tower fill the frame top to bottom; exactly three full-frame face close-ups: beetle 2.95, mosquito 7.4, ant 8.6; the ant in frame outside close-ups 1-2
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the fat bronze dung beetle boss; worker ants; A SWARM of them; ONE mosquito
props: ONE tower on the ant's back: gold coin stack, armchair on it, iron on the chair, potted ficus on top; ONE banknote ball; ONE bread loaf, torn to nothing by 6.8; ONE crumb; ONE wallpaper roll; ONE cardboard box; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy yard; a steep grassy anthill slope fills the background to the frame top; pebbles, twigs, bottle caps close behind him

audio.delivery: the ant's high squeaky voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.45-6.2 one unbroken flow; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, thumps, tearing bread, swarm patter, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: he already sprints, six legs a blur, as a huge foreground worker ant slams the potted ficus onto his tower; legs buckle in a wave, he races on
he sprints, jerking the tower higher with a shrug, as a foreground worker ant shoves a wallpaper roll under the armchair
a frame-edge worker ant hurls a cardboard box onto his armchair; mid-run he sinks, nose ploughing sand, springs up and races on, jaws clacking
close-up 1: the beetle boss's face fills the whole frame, jaws shut, forelegs yanking the coin stack from under the chair
box, roll, armchair, iron and ficus thump onto his back; legs splay flat, he scrambles up running; the beetle hind-kicks the coins into the banknote ball
he shrugs the tower up and races after the ball past the bread loaf as A SWARM of worker ants pours onto the loaf
the swarm, big in the foreground, rips the loaf into chunks and hauls them off at speed; he lunges a front leg toward it, nearly toppling
the last chunk is dragged away; ONE crumb bounces off it into his face; running, he heaves it onto his armchair
he races on, iron sliding, as the swarm scatters with the chunks; bare sand where the loaf was
close-up 2: ONE angry mosquito's face fills the whole frame, proboscis bared, biting into the crumb
the crumb snaps in half, tower lurching, sand bursting up round him; the mosquito zips off with its half
close-up 3: the ant's face fills the whole frame, gulping his half whole mid-run, cheeks bulging
he races on; the beetle flicks ONE gold coin onto the ficus; the tower teeters, he buckles and races past the bare sand

must_appear: ficus onto tower 0.0; beetle close-up 2.95; swarm tears loaf 4.95; crumb in face 6.2; bare sand 6.8; mosquito close-up 7.4; ant close-up 8.6; coin onto ficus 9.3
negative_prompt: held mic, a second mosquito, slow motion, slow walking, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, subtitles, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, duplicate props, floating objects, a hero running at the camera, a wide shot, a parked camera, a motionless first or last second, sky,standing on hind legs, a hero lying still, sideways scuttling, a side tracking shot, extras only in the background, any loaf left after 6.8
